title: Your Destiny
tagline: Embark on a wild blockchain journey as a curious crypto creature! Navigate decentralized realms, trade NFTs, outsmart scammers, and ally with AI agents. Your choices shape the story. Can you level up from noob to crypto legend?
description:
Your Destiny is an interactive, AI-driven storytelling game that brings blockchain transactions and NFT trading seamlessly into a rich narrative experience. Players progress through an unfolding storyline, encountering challenges that require on-chain interactions—like minting and trading NFTs—directly from within the game. This is all powered by AI agents that respond to natural language prompts, creating a uniquely immersive experience.

At its core, Your Destiny focuses on two major pillars:

AI-Driven Storytelling
We use OpenAI’s language models to generate dynamic, context-aware narrative arcs. As players respond to story prompts, the AI crafts new scenarios, dialogues, and outcomes, giving each player a customized game narrative.
Real Blockchain Integrations
By integrating AgentKit (by Coinbase Developer Platform) and deploying it via Autonome, our AI agent can manage a crypto wallet, mint NFTs, and facilitate transactions entirely from within the game. This means players can collect, trade, or showcase on-chain assets (NFTs) that they either earn or create in the storyline.
Additionally, the project incorporates Nillion’s SecretVault for secure data storage, allowing us to manage sensitive agent memory and user interactions in a way that still keeps public data accessible for gameplay. Beyond individual gameplay, we introduce a leaderboard that fosters friendly competition among users based on their trading achievements, in-game progress, and creative story collaborations.

Ultimately, Your Destiny exemplifies how autonomous AI agents, blockchain transactions, and narrative-driven gameplay can converge, delivering a seamless, immersive experience where the boundaries between game world and real-world digital assets disappear.
how_its_made:
We built Your Destiny with a blend of modern web technologies, AI services, and blockchain integrations that all come together under one cohesive experience. Below is a breakdown of our tech stack and the roles each component plays:

Frontend: Next.js + React

Next.js provides a robust framework for both server-side rendering and static site generation, ensuring optimal performance for the dynamic pages that serve our AI-generated story content.
React handles the interactive elements of the game’s user interface. It enables us to render real-time story updates, animate transitions between narrative sequences, and keep the game state in sync with blockchain transactions.
Backend: Express.js + OpenAI API + NOVITA

Express.js serves as the main backend, orchestrating requests between the frontend and various APIs (OpenAI, blockchain services, etc.).
OpenAI API fuels the AI-driven storytelling. The backend sends user inputs and game states to the API to generate narrative continuations, character dialogues, and item descriptions (which can then be minted as NFTs).
NOVITA is used to generate images about the current scene that lets players feel inside the story.

AgentKit by Coinbase Developer Platform

This is our linchpin for blockchain integration. We leverage AgentKit to give our AI agent access to on-chain actions—like initiating transactions, minting NFTs, and reading blockchain states.

Being integrated via Autonome means we can deploy and manage these AI agents at scale. When the AI determines a player action (e.g., “Mint a ‘Dragon’s Breath Sword’ NFT”), it triggers an AgentKit script to perform the on-chain transaction in real time.
Nillion’s SecretVault

We use SecretVault to securely store sensitive information such as agent memory, private user data, and knowledge bases that should not be exposed publicly.
This storage solution allows players’ and agents’ private states to remain encrypted and protected while still allowing relevant public data to be queried by anyone.

Combining these elements, Your Destiny offers a truly next-generation experience: an AI-driven, narrative-based game where every on-chain transaction, NFT mint, and user action is orchestrated by a behind-the-scenes AI agent. By blending real-time AI storytelling with actual blockchain ownership and trading, we deliver an immersive story world that extends seamlessly into the real world of crypto collectibles.
